A Snapshot of Your Day

We are looking for a Cost Manager to join our Offshore Sales department, where you will be working on Sales projects for the world leaders in Offshore Wind. You will be a core sales team member; a team that is a multidisciplinary and intercultural expert function with interfaces across international borders. Your main stakeholders are: Project Management, Construction, Engineering, Service, Operations, Hub Management, Sales Project Management, Sales Solutions, PPM.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• You are responsible for the offer sales calculation for international investment projects with the contract volume of 300 Million – 3000 Million EUR.

• You are a core sales team member; a multidisciplinary and intercultural expert function with interfaces across international borders; your main stakeholders are: Project Management, Construction, Engineering, Service, Operations, Hub Management, Sales Project Management, Sales Solutions, PPM.

• Ensure cost comparison and explanation on cost deltas for different project scopes and during project phases (e.g. SBA calculation vs As Sold calculation vs OIC)

• You are responsible for a timely calculation completeness and adherence to cost approval process with input functions; you ensure and support commercial commitment (sign-off) by executing function of costs

• Ensure the basis for cash flow planning and the hedging strategy which includes the calculation of the project specific Cash Flow profile, the request of currency rates/hedging cost and the evaluation of project specific currency baskets

• You are responsible for transparency on, comparability of, and adherence to pre-agreed cost improvement measure as basis for approvals (“Profit / GM bridge”)

• You ensure the overview on offer costing with the aim of achieving increased cost transparency via the identification of main cost drivers and KPIs and by that contributing to competitive cost solutions

• Drive, together with the assigned sales team, the successful Target Costing execution through benchmarks, cross project comparisons, cost input analysis based on KPIs.

• Leading the yearly cost update validation across departments and participate in knowledge sharing, feedback loop and development of the calculation tools.

What You Bring

• Commercial knowledge related to KPI’s, SGRE processes, reporting and value flows

• Experience in Project Cost and Warranty calculation is preferred

• Experience in project team management and working with different international stakeholders within an intercultural working environment

• Teamwork and intercultural experience, strong communication skills

• Strong degree of entrepreneurial spirit and passion to the field of responsibility

• Fluent English is essential; German and/or any other languages are of course welcome

• Flexibility to travel

• Important capabilities: self-determination, take own-initiative, business competence, communication skills, create network built on trust, analytical skills, result and quality orientation, customer focus (external/internal), professional ethics.

About the Team

Wind Power division is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our cross-border team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is supported by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character - no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Flexible and hybrid working environment (office and/or home).

• Flexible work schedules guarantee a good work life balance.

• Continuous professional and personal development opportunities.

• Be in an international and open-minded team.

• Reasonable training plan for the starting period.

#LI-GG1

Data centres play a vital role in society, and the decisions made today will shape the digital and sustainable infrastructure of tomorrow. At COWI, we are strengthening our capabilities to support clients in delivering the next generation of digital infrastructure. We are looking for an experienced Mechanical Lead with a background from data centre projects to help strengthen and expand our growing data centre business across Scandinavia.

Lead the mechanical design of next-generation data centres

Data centres are a strategic growth area at COWI, and we are continuing to strengthen our multidisciplinary capabilities across Scandinavia. By combining expertise in engineering, architecture, sustainability and project delivery, we support clients throughout the development of complex digital infrastructure projects and help shape the next generation of reliable and energy-efficient facilities. Your work location wil be at one of COWI'S offices in either Lyngby, Aarhus or Odense based on your preference.

In this role, you will take a leading position within the mechanical discipline, contributing your expertise to complex projects from early planning through detailed design and implementation.

As Mechanical Lead, you will play a key role in developing cooling and HVAC solutions for mission-critical facilities, balancing performance, reliability and sustainability requirements. Working closely with colleagues across engineering disciplines, architects and clients, you will help ensure technically robust and coordinated solutions throughout the project lifecycle. We expect that you have work experience from hyperscale data centre projects.

You will join an established engineering environment where technical quality, collaboration and knowledge sharing are highly valued. At the same time, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the continued development of our data centre expertise and project delivery capabilities across Scandinavia.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

• Lead mechanical design and advisory services for data centre facilities.

• Act as the discipline lead, ensuring technical quality and coordination throughout projects.

• Lead the design and development of mechanical systems for hyperscale and enterprise data centers.

• Engage with clients and stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into practical engineering solutions.

• Support projects through concept development, detailed design, tendering and construction phases.

• Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated and efficient technical solutions.

Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

On top of that, you will have:

• A relevant educational background in engineering.

• Proven experience delivering data centre projects, ideally within hyperscale, colocation or enterprise environments.

• Experience leading technical design work within multidisciplinary project environments.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Additional role-specific qualifications may include:

• Experience working with large-scale infrastructure or industrial facilities.

Some projects may be subject to specific security requirements, and the ability to obtain relevant security clearance may be required.

Do you have more questions?

If you have any unanswered questions about the role or what we have to offer, please reach out to Senior Talent Acuisition Specialist, Mette Gutte at mtgt@cowi.com. Get to know our work with data centre projects even better here: Can you make tomorrow’s digital infrastructure feel at home?

A place to work and so much more

At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Before you apply

All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, so the role may close as soon as we find the right match.

Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

We’re looking for an experienced Customer Success Manager, to manage, assist and consult our customers on the DACH market and ensure a strong long term relationship. You will handle customer cycles from onboarding to renewal, and be able to have a clear impact on how we manage our customers now and going forward.

This role can be based in our Copenhagen HQ or in Hamburg.

**About Pandektes

**Legal research hasn’t changed much in decades. Lawyers still spend countless hours navigating fragmented sources, outdated systems, and complex databases just to find the information they need.

At Pandektes, we’re changing that.

Our ambition is to build the leading global platform for legal research and the largest AI-powered legal database. By combining artificial intelligence, intelligent search, and continuously updated legal sources, we’re redefining how legal knowledge is accessed, understood, analyzed, and applied.

Pandektes has raised more than _€_17.5 million and most recently closed a _€_13.5 million Series A round (October 2026) led by Alstin Capital, PROfounders and Scale Capital. Pandektes already serves more than 450 customers across Denmark, Germany and Switzerland.

We’re still early in the journey, and joining our team now means you’ll have big impact on shaping how we scale.

**About The Role

**You will join our current team of three in Customer Success to work on serving our German-speaking customers. As an early member of the team, you will be able to have an instant impact on the customer experience.

This is a full-cycle CSM position, which means you will handle everything from onboarding to renewal. This means we’re looking for someone who is passionate about strong customer relations, but ideally also with a knack for teaching. When it comes to contracts and numbers, you’ll be working closely with our account executives to ensure we find the best fit for our customers.

As the team is young, we hope that you will also want to be a part of shaping the processes and future of CS at Pandektes.

**What You’ll Do

**

• Onboarding customers - Teach lawyers and legal professionals how AI can superpower their legal research

• Drive adoption - Collaborate with management/executives to ensure adoption and success

• Build community - Find superusers and empower them to do even more with Pandektes

• Foster growth - Identify expansion opportunities and work with the rest of our team to expand our presence at existing customers

**What You’ll Bring

**

• Fluency in German and English

• Entrepreneurial mindset, motivated by creating good relationships, top-notch customer experience and driving growth as part of our commercial team

• Experience with Customer Success in a SaaS B2B company and/or a legal background

• Excellent communication skills and strong ability to build trust – we value long-term customer relationships

• Eagerness to learn and openness to feedback; you value insights from others and use them to grow

• Proactive mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively

• Strong interest in technology and enthusiasm for AI (basic knowledge of AI and LLMs is a plus)

• Willingness to develop deep knowledge of how lawyers work and conduct legal research (a legal background is an advantage but not required)

**How We Work

**We place great value on a vibrant, inspiring, and challenging company culture. This is achieved through a talented and passionate team that believes in achieving great things together.

We value ownership – you can expect a lot of freedom and responsibility. The key is open communication, trust, and a shared passion to transform the legal world.

We are a growing team based in Copenhagen, Hamburg, London and Zurich.

**What we offer

**

• Competitive compensation + commission

• An attractive warrant program

• A collaborative work environment where your input is not only valued but often implemented within hours

• 25 vacation days per year + public holidays

• International team events – last time we went to Barcelona, and we’d love to have you join us next time

• Your own Pleo card for necessary work expenses

• Paid parental leave

**Pandektes is an equal opportunity employer

**_We believe diverse teams build better products and stronger teams. We embrace and encourage people from all backgrounds to apply regardless of race/ethnicity, colour, religion, nationality, gender, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, socio-economic status, culture or beliefs.

Our operations team is looking for a Finance Manager who is tired of the status quo. You will work closely with our software engineers and operations team to help shape the future of finance in property management.

To be quite frank: if you currently work with bookkeeping in property management, you probably know the pain. Too much manual work, outdated systems, endless reconciliations, and processes built around software from another decade.

We want to change that. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to rethink and shape how bookkeeping and accounting workflows should work for our customers' property portfolio.

Right now is the best time to join because you’ll help define both the role and the systems behind it as we scale across the Nordics.

****What we do

****Property management is fundamentally broken. It’s held back by legacy software and linear scaling: more tenants equals more manual work.

We automate high-volume, low-value tasks like bank reconciliation, debt collection, and financial administration to remove unnecessary friction and human error from the rental experience.

Rumli is a seal of quality and trust in a messy market. After years of scaling our software to thousands of users, we are now rebuilding our entire stack from the ground up with AI as the foundation. We are moving from being a software provider to a full-service property manager.

We’re not just building the platform; we’re running it.

****You will

• Be a core part of the team: Work closely with operations and product to improve financial workflows and internal systems.

• Handle day-to-day bookkeeping: ensure our automations work as intended across reconciliation, vendor invoice management, payroll and financial administration for the properties we manage.

• Ensure financial accuracy: Manage balance sheet reconciliations, payments, VAT handling, and monthly, quarterly and yearly accounts.

• Help improve the system: Identify repetitive or inefficient workflows and help the product team decide what to automate next.

• Operate at scale: Use modern tools and automation to manage a portfolio size that would be difficult in a traditional setup.

• Support the business: Assist with designing the reporting, budgeting, on- and offboarding of new properties, and ad hoc finance tasks as we continue to grow.

****You may be a fit if you are

• From the field: You have experience with bookkeeping, accounting, or financial administration – ideally within property management or a related industry.

• Done with manual work and outdated processes: You’ve worked with legacy bookkeeping and already have opinions on how finance workflows could be smarter.

• Detail-oriented: You care about accuracy and structure without losing sight of the bigger picture.

• A systems thinker: You enjoy improving processes, not just following them.

• Comfortable with IT systems: You have worked with different software, like e-conomic, before and are quick at adopting new ones.

• Bilingual: You are fluent in Danish and comfortable working in English.

• Equipped with an entrepreneurial mindset: You’re comfortable taking ownership and working in a fast-paced startup environment.

****What you’ll get

****Almost everyone lives or works in a building someone else looks after, and how that is done has barely changed in decades. Rumli is rethinking it – and you'll be part of the team making it happen, backed by some of Denmark's leading investors. The distance from idea to action here is short, and impact gets noticed fast.

• Ownership of the company through our warrant program.

• An office in the heart of Copenhagen.

• Daily lunch, drinks and snacks at the office.

• Private health insurance.

• 30 days of paid holiday.

We're looking for people, not bullet points on a CV. Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If this sounds like you and you want to build something that matters with people who care, we'd love to hear from you.

Experienced Backend Developer for UBsend A/S

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark

Travel: Approximately 10-30 days per year

Looking for the next step in your career?

Do you have 4-5 years+ of experience as a software developer? Are you eager to play a central role in a highly skilled team? Do you want to work with the latest technologies on a cloud-native platform and be part of an exciting scale-up company with the potential to disrupt the transportation and logistics industry?

If so, our IT department in Copenhagen is looking for an ambitious, dedicated and skilled backend developer to build and maintain a best-in-class IT solution.

Who is UBsend?

UBsend is a scale-up company aiming for developing and implementing state-of-the-art logistic solutions within the parcel industry. We ensure that companies of all sizes receive optimal solutions for their parcels in terms of carrier selection, lead time, prices, track and trace and customer experience. We strive to be the leading integration platform, growing rapidly and working with many well-known B2B and B2C clients. We are a company with a multinational culture, counting roughly 80 employees between our offices in Aarhus and Copenhagen. We keep the daily motivation high through social events and a down-to-earth tone with lots of humor and an inclusive atmosphere.

The IT Department

You will join our IT department of 22 colleagues. The department is responsible for developing new products and components and maintaining existing integrations between carriers and customers. Projects and solutions you will work on include:

• Development and implementation of a new enterprise platform in microservice architecture

• Development of carrier and transportation integrations

• Track and trace and event management

Our solutions are developed with an object-oriented approach, utilizing software design patterns when relevant. We aim to deliver the best solutions for our customers while enjoying an informal culture. We use Scrum methodologies and apply test-driven and domain-driven development with API-first approaches.

Key Technologies

Our technology stack includes:

• Languages & Frameworks: Java 17+21, Spring Boot, NodeJS, TypeScript, Angular CLI

• Data & Messaging: Confluent Kafka, Spring Data, MongoDB, Elasticsearch

• Infrastructure: Kubernetes (AKS), Docker, Terraform, Helm, Azure, Maven, BitBucket + Pipelines, Grafana

The position

Your main task will be to develop and maintain state-of-the-art applications, creating a solid and smooth foundation for operations. You will work with Microsoft Azure as our infrastructure platform. You will be given significant responsibility and the opportunity to implement your ideas in a team-oriented environment.

Daily Tasks

• Building new features into our native cloud microservices Java platform

• Conducting thorough code reviews (e.g., pull-requests) and working closely with QA

• Integrating with partners to produce the best possible integrations

• Defining and implementing automated testing to support our CI & CD

• Defining architectural solutions and improvements for the services you work on

• Identifying and defining viable improvements to our way of working

• Designing solutions with IT colleagues and business counterparts

• Sharing knowledge and experiences with your team members and colleagues

Qualifications

• More than 4 years of experience in Java (primary programming language)

• Writing maintainable (clean, readable, reusable and well documented) code

• Extensive knowledge of software design patterns and principles

• Familiarity with relational and document databases. We use MongoDB

• Experience with microservices architecture and design-first principles of APIs

• Familiarity with Microsoft Azure as a platform

• Excellent English communication skills (company language)

• Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in CS / Software Engineering (or related fields)

Your profile

We tackle a wide range of projects, so if you love staying busy and enjoy variety in your workday, you'll fit right in with us. You have an entrepreneurial spirit and always go the extra mile to achieve your goals and meet deadlines.

Since we're not a large corporate IT department, you'll be given significant responsibility, making it crucial that you're comfortable making independent decisions when needed. You bring a positive and innovative mindset and aren't afraid to pitch and implement your ideas. You thrive in an informal environment and are eager to both learn more and share your knowledge. In short – you're a proactive “go-getter” who loves a challenge!

We look forward to hearing from you

If you have any questions, please contact IT manager Jesper Elgaard at jesper.elgaard@ubsend.com.

Please note that we are already covered by agencies in this area, and we are not interested in being contacted by external agencies regarding this vacancy.

Please send your CV and application as soon as possible. We’re doing ongoing interviews and will remove this listing once we’ve found the right new colleague.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a DevOps & Platform Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in building, operating, and continuously enhancing the platforms and services that drive product development, testing, validation, deployment, and operations within Siemens Gamesa’s digital ecosystem. Imagine developing automation solutions, enhancing CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with software teams to elevate the developer experience and operational efficiency. You will work closely with product development, validation, architecture, and infrastructure teams to ensure that our platforms remain reliable, secure, and scalable. Whether you are modernizing platform services or contributing to cloud-enabled solutions, your efforts will significantly accelerate how engineering teams deliver innovative solutions. Become part of an international team that values ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing in a culture driven by a strong engineering mindset.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Design, build, and operate platform services that support product development, testing, validation, and deployment activities.

• Develop automation solutions that enhance reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

• Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code, automated deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and platform tooling.

• Develop integrations and automation using APIs, scripting, and modern DevOps practices.

• Improve observability through monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational analytics.

• Support and evolve virtualization and platform technologies while contributing to modernization initiatives and future cloud capabilities.

• Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product teams, and infrastructure specialists to enhance developer productivity and platform capabilities.

• Contribute to platform standardization, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You Bring

Must Have

• Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Software Engineering, or Infrastructure Automation.

• Strong experience with automation technologies such as Ansible, PowerShell, PowerCLI, Python, Git, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD tooling.

• Proven ability to create and maintain automation frameworks, deployment pipelines, APIs, integrations, or platform services.

• Familiarity with virtualization and platform technologies like VMware vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, ESXi, Proxmox VE, or similar enterprise platforms.

• Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and system integration.

• Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, performance analysis, and service reliability practices.

• A proactive mindset with a passion for automation, continuous learning, and building reliable platform services.

Nice to Have

• Exposure to cloud-native technologies, containers, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud platforms.

• Experience in Agile environments using Scrum or SAFe methodologies, along with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows.

• Familiarity with platform modernization, self-service platforms, developer experience initiatives, or Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Experience supporting engineering applications, industrial systems, SCADA environments, or operational technology solutions.

About the Team

You will join the Infrastructure Performance & Operations (IPO) team within Digital Products & Solutions. This team is dedicated to developing, operating, and evolving the digital platforms that support product engineering, validation, testing, and business operations across Siemens Gamesa. Our focus areas include platform engineering, automation, virtualization, CI/CD, observability, service reliability, infrastructure modernization, and operational excellence. We collaborate closely with product teams to simplify operations through automation, enhance developer experience, and provide scalable platform capabilities that support the development, validation, and delivery of digital products in the wind energy sector. Working in an Agile environment, we utilize Scrum and SAFe practices, ensuring alignment across development, infrastructure, architecture, validation, and product organizations. As our digital landscape evolves, the team is also shaping future platform capabilities, cloud adoption opportunities, and next-generation Digital Foundation services. We value collaboration, technical curiosity, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and engineers who thrive on solving complex challenges through code, automation, and modern platform engineering practices.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: Working at Siemens Energy: Careers & Job Opportunities

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

Here are examples of the rewards and benefits Siemens Energy offers:

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Opportunities to work on and lead a variety of innovative projects

• Medical benefits

• Hybrid (3x per week in the office) / Flexible work

• Time off/Paid holidays and parental leave

• Continual learning through the Learn@Siemens-Energy platform

• Access to a variety of employee resource groups

_Are you technically curious, service-minded, and motivated by helping customers resolve critical technical issues? Do you enjoy combining troubleshooting with coordination and clear communication? If so, this could be your next career opportunity.

**Your position

**As our new Senior Support Specialist, Telecom, you will support the daily operation of our customers communication Systems. You will take ownership of incoming requests, gather the necessary technical information, assess urgency and operational impact, and perform structured troubleshooting. When specialist assistance is required, you will coordinate the correct escalation and ensure that customers remain informed throughout the process.

You are not expected to be the specialist for every system. Your role is to establish a clear overview, perform the agreed initial checks, document findings and decisions, and ensure that each case is resolved.

Your place of work will be at our Global HQ located in Esbjerg in a full-time position. You must be willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation according to an agreed schedule.

**Your Tasks & Responsibilities

**Your work will include receiving customer calls and service requests, monitoring tickets and alarms, carrying out remote troubleshooting, and coordinating technical responses. You will maintain technical records, contribute to service reporting and preventive-maintenance activities, and help improve service procedures and documentation.

**Your Tasks Will Include But Are Not Limited To

**

• Manage service tickets from initial request through resolution.

• Perform troubleshooting and monitor systems through Zabbix or comparable platforms

• Keep customers informed and ensure that technical findings, communication, and agreed actions are documented accurately

**Your Profile & Qualifications

**You are service-minded, technically curious, and comfortable taking responsibility. You approach technical issues systematically and communicate clearly with customers and colleagues. You do not need to be a specialist in every system, but you are motivated to investigate issues, perform structured trouble shooting, and coordinate the right technical support.

**To Succeed In This Position, We Imagine That You

**

• Have a technical background within telecom, networking or related field

• Have practical experience with technical troubleshooting and fault handling

• Strong Microsoft Office software knowledge

• Are comfortable using ticketing systems and documenting technical findings, customer communication, and agreed actions

• Communicate clearly in written and spoken English

• Are willing and able to participate in a 24/7 on-call rotation

Experience with telecom systems such as PABX, TETRA, VHF, AIS, CCTV, PAGA, LTE or Network infrastructure would also be beneficial. General knowledge with, Window, Linux, Proxmox, Zabbix, TOPdesk, or comparable systems, but your technical curiosity and willingness to learn are equally important.

**Welcome to Semco Maritime

**At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.

Care to join the movement?

Change. With us.

A Snapshot of Your Day

Join us as a DevOps & Platform Engineer, where you will play a pivotal role in building, operating, and continuously enhancing the platforms and services that drive product development, testing, validation, deployment, and operations within Siemens Gamesa’s digital ecosystem. Imagine developing automation solutions, enhancing CI/CD pipelines, and collaborating with software teams to elevate the developer experience and operational efficiency. You will work closely with product development, validation, architecture, and infrastructure teams to ensure that our platforms remain reliable, secure, and scalable. Whether you are modernizing platform services or contributing to cloud-enabled solutions, your efforts will significantly accelerate how engineering teams deliver innovative solutions. Become part of an international team that values ownership, innovation, and knowledge sharing in a culture driven by a strong engineering mindset.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Design, build, and operate platform services that support product development, testing, validation, and deployment activities.

• Develop automation solutions that enhance reliability, scalability, security, and operational efficiency.

• Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code, automated deployments, CI/CD pipelines, and platform tooling.

• Develop integrations and automation using APIs, scripting, and modern DevOps practices.

• Improve observability through monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and operational analytics.

• Support and evolve virtualization and platform technologies while contributing to modernization initiatives and future cloud capabilities.

• Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product teams, and infrastructure specialists to enhance developer productivity and platform capabilities.

• Contribute to platform standardization, self-service capabilities, and continuous improvement initiatives.

What You Bring

Must Have

• Experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), Software Engineering, or Infrastructure Automation.

• Strong experience with automation technologies such as Ansible, PowerShell, PowerCLI, Python, Git, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD tooling.

• Proven ability to create and maintain automation frameworks, deployment pipelines, APIs, integrations, or platform services.

• Familiarity with virtualization and platform technologies like VMware vSphere, vCenter, vSAN, ESXi, Proxmox VE, or similar enterprise platforms.

• Knowledge of Linux and/or Windows administration, scripting, troubleshooting, and system integration.

• Experience with monitoring, observability, logging, incident management, performance analysis, and service reliability practices.

• A proactive mindset with a passion for automation, continuous learning, and building reliable platform services.

Nice to Have

• Exposure to cloud-native technologies, containers, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or hybrid cloud platforms.

• Experience in Agile environments using Scrum or SAFe methodologies, along with tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Git-based workflows.

• Familiarity with platform modernization, self-service platforms, developer experience initiatives, or Infrastructure as Code practices.

• Experience supporting engineering applications, industrial systems, SCADA environments, or operational technology solutions.

About the Team

You will join the Infrastructure Performance & Operations (IPO) team within Digital Products & Solutions. This team is dedicated to developing, operating, and evolving the digital platforms that support product engineering, validation, testing, and business operations across Siemens Gamesa. Our focus areas include platform engineering, automation, virtualization, CI/CD, observability, service reliability, infrastructure modernization, and operational excellence. We collaborate closely with product teams to simplify operations through automation, enhance developer experience, and provide scalable platform capabilities that support the development, validation, and delivery of digital products in the wind energy sector. Working in an Agile environment, we utilize Scrum and SAFe practices, ensuring alignment across development, infrastructure, architecture, validation, and product organizations. As our digital landscape evolves, the team is also shaping future platform capabilities, cloud adoption opportunities, and next-generation Digital Foundation services. We value collaboration, technical curiosity, knowledge sharing, continuous learning, and engineers who thrive on solving complex challenges through code, automation, and modern platform engineering practices.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking talented individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: Working at Siemens Energy: Careers & Job Opportunities

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

jobs.occupation: Service Technology and Automation Lead - Global Service
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced and commercially minded Service Technology and Automation Lead to modernize our global Customer Service setup. You will drive the implementation of service technology, AI and automation to deliver best-in-class customer experience while improving operational efficiency.

Working closely with Global and Local Service teams, you will optimize processes, develop our global service platform and translate business needs into practical solutions. Your focus will be on increasing efficiency, strengthening service quality and making it easier for customers and partners to do business with us.

**Welcome to Global Sales

**You will join Global Sales, Training and Service within Demant’s Hearing Aids business, where we work to improve the lives of people with hearing loss around the world. We deliver product and sales training, commercial excellence and customer service excellence to our sales companies across Europe, Asia-Pacific, Latin America, the Middle East and Africa, as well as to our independent distributors.

You will become part of our newly established Global Service department, consisting of 14 colleagues. Reporting to the Head of Global Service and joining the Global Service leadership team, you will help define and implement service excellence across our global organization.

**Drive Global Service Efficiency and Automation

**Joining us, you will drive the digitalization of Customer Service through standardized processes, modern technology, AI and automation. You will collaborate with local teams to identify opportunities, develop solutions and ensure successful implementation and adoption.

Success requires a good understanding of Customer Service operations and the ability to use technology to improve efficiency without compromising the personal relationships that underpin great service.

In this role, you will:

• Own and develop Salesforce Service Cloud, including its global rollout, functionality, user experience and roadmap.

• Drive platform adoption and performance, using data and insights to help markets maximize value and identify improvements.

• Implement AI and automation solutions to optimize workflows, improve service quality and increase operational efficiency.

• Define global service standards and guide markets in optimizing technologies such as IVR, workforce management and knowledge repositories.

• Develop customer and partner integrations for larger customers, maintaining the integration roadmap with Global IT.

• Drive stakeholder engagement and implementation, building alignment and momentum across global and local teams.

You can expect approximately 10–20 travel days per year to support our markets and understand local service operations.

**What You Bring

**You hold a relevant commercial master’s degree and ideally have around five years of experience in a similar function, preferably within a larger international organization. You have a track record of improving Customer Service performance and implementing new solutions.

You understand Customer Service at strategic, tactical and operational levels and know how to optimize processes, systems and ways of working. With a good commercial mindset, you recognize how service excellence contributes to customer satisfaction and business performance.

You thrive at the intersection of Customer Service, data, AI and technology. You have experience implementing AI solutions in a business context and translating insights into measurable improvements. Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, Power BI or similar platforms is an advantage.

As a colleague, you are structured, analytical and collaborative. You can lead projects across organizational boundaries, influence and challenge stakeholders at different levels, and balance global standards with local needs. Your excellent communication and presentation skills enable you to build relationships and create engagement across cultures and functions.

**Come and join us

**This is an opportunity to shape the future of Customer Service across Demant’s global Hearing Aids business. You will work with colleagues and stakeholders across international markets to make our service operations more efficient, scalable and customer-focused through technology, AI and automation.

If you enjoy combining commercial insight, technology and collaboration to create tangible business improvements, we would like to hear from you.

Please submit your CV before the application deadline on November 5.

For inquiries regarding the application process, please use the online application form.

To learn more about the position, contact Steen Busk Marner, Head of Global Service, at skma@demant.com.

We are curious to meet you!

**Recruitment Process Information

**We will begin inviting candidates for interviews after the application deadline. First round of interviews are scheduled for the 12, 13, 16, and 17 of November. You can expect the final round of interviews to be held on the 24 and 25 of November.

STUDIO 9 is looking for a commercially driven Sales Manager to turn strong customer interest in KEYSTONE into signed contracts and long-term partnerships.

This role carries clear responsibility for the sales pipeline and the full commercial process, from initial customer dialogue and pilot to negotiation and agreement.

ABOUT KEYSTONE

KEYSTONE is STUDIO 9’s SaaS platform that enables our customers to collect, structure and manage product data directly from their suppliers.

The platform makes it easier for our customers to meet the evolving compliance requirements in areas spanning from EUDR, supply chain traceability, digital product passport (DPP) and LCA. It is built as a SaaS platform that can easily integrate into our customers’ system landscape (e.g. to their ERP and PIM-system).

ABOUT THE ROLE

Working closely with our Sales Director and Software & Implementation team, you will drive KEYSTONE’s commercial growth and help shape how the platform is positioned, sold and delivered.

You will lead the customer journey from the first conversation through agreement, onboarding and long-term development. This includes identifying the right decision-makers, building support across the customer’s organisation and presenting a clear financial and operational case for choosing KEYSTONE.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Drive customer acquisition and commercial growth for KEYSTONE

• Own the sales process from initial dialogue to signed agreement

• Progress opportunities through demonstrations, pilots, negotiations and internal approvals

• Identify decision-makers and build support across the customer’s organisation

• Build compelling ROI cases that demonstrate KEYSTONE’s financial and operational value

• Maintain a structured pipeline with forecasts and clear next steps

• Ensure a smooth transition from sales to implementation

• Support customer adoption, retention and account growth

• Bring customer insights into product positioning and business development, collaborating closely with Sales, Product and Software teams

ABOUT YOU

You are motivated by progressing sales opportunities and turning interest into lasting customer relationships. You work in a structured way, create momentum and follow opportunities through to completion.

You are comfortable exploring a customer’s software landscape, understanding how systems, data and workflows connect, and translating software capabilities into clear business value. You can engage both commercial and IT stakeholders in conversations about business needs, integrations and scalability.

You bring:

• Proven results in B2B sales within SaaS, software or digital solutions, combined with an understanding of enterprise systems such as ERP, CRM, PIM and PLM platforms

• The ability to discuss APIs, system integrations and product data flows at a commercial level, connecting technical requirements to customer needs

• Experience managing complex sales cycles from discovery and qualification through solution presentations, proposal development and contract negotiation

• The ability to build a convincing business case around ROI, operational efficiency and data quality

• Strong stakeholder management

• A disciplined approach to CRM, pipeline management and sales forecasting

Experience with product information management (PIM), master data, supply chain processes or compliance is an advantage, as is knowledge of the fashion, furniture and lifestyle industries.

WHAT WE OFFER

You will join KEYSTONE early in its growth journey and play a central role in shaping how the platform is sold and scaled. You will have high ownership, close collaboration across teams, and the opportunity to make a visible impact.

We offer a flexible working environment with our headquarters located by the harbour in Horsens, Denmark. While we value in-person collaboration, we are open to candidates based elsewhere and support remote working arrangements.

READY TO GROW KEYSTONE?

Send your application and CV as soon as possible. We review applications and conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. If you have questions about the role, please contact Sales Director Rasmus Ravnholt: rasmus.ravnholt@nineunited.com. We look forward to hearing from you.

ABOUT STUDIO 9

At STUDIO 9, we work with branding in every detail. We design and develop physical brand experiences for international fashion, jewellery and lifestyle brands – from garment accessories such as labels and hangtags to packaging, shop fixtures, window displays and complete retail environments.

Our work covers the entire process, from the initial idea and design development to compliance, sourcing, production and delivery.

STUDIO 9 is part of the Nine United family, with our headquarters in Horsens and sourcing offices across Europe and Asia. We are a close-knit team with a culture built on collaboration, trust and strong relationships.

Why this role

We are a consulting firm that helps life sciences companies, locally and globally, get their commercial data right, from master data and data platforms to customer engagement programmes.

This role has two sides. With clients, you’ll be the data architect they rely on: setting up data governance, running the design authority and making the calls that keep their data landscape coherent. Inside BASE, you’ll help lead our Commercial data team by developing people, shaping proposals and helping us win new work. We don’t expect you to be equally strong on both sides, and we’ll shape the role around where you bring the most.

What you’ll do

With clients:

• Act as lead data architect on MDM and data platform programmes for life sciences clients

• Set up and run data governance, including ownership, standards and decision rights

• Chair design authority meetings and make the architecture calls across MDM, data platform and CRM integration

• Work with client stakeholders, from business owners to IT leadership

Inside BASE:

• Manage and develop consultants in our data team

• Lead or contribute to RFP responses and solution proposals

• Present in client orals and pre-sales meetings

• Share knowledge and help grow our data practice

What you bring

• A proven track record in a leading role on MDM or data platform implementations, deep in one and credible across both:

• MDM (e.g. Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM)

• data platforms (e.g. Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica IDMC)

• Hands-on experience with data governance and with running a design authority or similar architecture forum

• Experience managing and developing people

• Pre-sales experience, such as RFP responses, proposals or orals

• A good understanding of delivery methodologies such as Agile, waterfall and hybrid

• A general understanding of customer engagement (CE) processes such as CRM, marketing automation, consent management, and event and engagement management

• Confident communication, spoken and written, with both business and technical audiences

• Excellent English

A plus if you have

• Deep knowledge of one or more CE processes

• A certification in an MDM solution (Informatica MDM, Reltio MDM) or a data platform (Databricks, Snowflake, Informatica)

• Good knowledge of the data models of at least one key data provider: IQVIA OneKey, IQVIA sales and prescription data, or Veeva OpenData

• GAMP 5 training or hands-on experience

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2007, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting enterprise working exclusively in the life sciences industry.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Europe and the United States, we support clients globally. We work closely with our customers to identify, develop, and implement initiatives that drive growth, efficiency, and meaningful change. Through partnerships with leading solution providers such as Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Benchling, and MediSpend, we help our clients unlock the full potential of modern technologies.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact.

You will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing environment where:

• Ambition is encouraged through ownership and continuous learning

• Execution matters — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice

• Team spirit and trust guide collaboration across roles, countries, and disciplines

• Openness means your ideas are heard, you are challenged constructively, and supported as you grow

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

By submitting your application, you consent to the processing of your personal data by BASE life science for the purposes of recruitment and selection. This includes the collection, storage, and use of your personal data as outlined in our Privacy Policy.

jobs.description:
You will architect and optimize scalable data pipelines, datasets and analytical workflows at EPAM in Copenhagen, Denmark, working in a hybrid model. Initially at one of our Clients in the Advanced Manufacturing / Life Sciences space. Using Snowflake, Dataiku, SQL and Python, you enable feature engineering for machine learning and support robust data products for analytics and business intelligence. You collaborate with data science, product and delivery teams to deliver production-ready solutions with a focus on data quality, performance and maintainability.

**Responsibilities

**

• Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and analytical workflows using Snowflake and Dataiku

• Write and optimize SQL for data transformation, feature engineering and analytical use cases

• Develop and maintain data models, datasets and views in Snowflake for downstream consumption

• Create, validate and maintain reusable features in Dataiku for machine learning models

• Leverage existing features and datasets to reduce duplication and improve consistency

• Implement automated testing, monitoring and CI/CD for production data pipelines

• Ensure data quality and follow enterprise data governance and security standards

• Troubleshoot data issues across pipelines, including upstream AWS services

• Support data requirements for analytics, reporting and business intelligence

• Collaborate with data science, product and delivery teams to translate business needs into reliable data solutions

**

• 6-8+ years of Data Engineering experience at Enterprise scale

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake and Dataiku

• Strong SQL skills, including query optimization and data transformation

• Proficiency in Python for data engineering workflows

• Experience building and maintaining production data pipelines

• Solid understanding of data modeling and feature engineering for analytics and machine learning

• Experience with automated testing, monitoring and CI/CD for data pipelines

• Familiarity with AWS data services, such as Lambda, S3, Glue and Step Functions, for troubleshooting upstream pipelines

• Ability to work effectively within governed enterprise environments

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate across technical and business teams

**Nice to have

**

• Experience in healthcare, life sciences or customer-support analytics

• Familiarity with feature stores and reusable feature management

• Experience supporting business intelligence and reporting datasets

Imagine a future where you are a key part of our Asset Integrity Team operating some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets both onshore and offshore

Welcome to Asset Integrity

You’ll be part of Asset Integrity where you, together with your engineering colleague will support the organisation with your mechanical engineering skills in the operation, inspection, engineering, integrity and asset management. As a team we foster collaboration and innovation. We are a group of ambitious professionals within different engineering disciplines, who are passionate and motivated and who value teamwork as an essential part of safeguarding our assets.

You’ll play an important role in:

• executing various engineering studies and tasks for onshore oil&gas terminals and offshore and onshore pipelines both internally and by defining scope of work and liaison with external engineering consultants

• performing inspection data analysis and integrity assessment of our approx 800km of pipelines

• supporting the offshore inspection and maintenance campaigns.

• liaison with Authorities, Contractors, Oil&Gas companies and other third parties.

• act as offshore company representative/supervisor onboard contractors’ vessels

• ensure and perform engineering and quality check and final delivery of inspection results to our Integrity engineers

• providing input to budgets and reporting to management.

Once familiar with our systems, you will be included in a 24/7 duty roster to respond to emergency situations.

To succeed in the role, you:

• have key focus on safety, which shall be embedded in all the work you do;

• hold an engineering degree, preferably in mechanical engineering

• have experience working with oil&gas plant and pipeline integrity and engineering both onshore and offshore

• have experience working with engineering companies, contractors and/or suppliers;

• have experience working with practical onshore and offshore pipeline operation and maintenance as well as experience in marine and subsea operations and inspection methods

• have a proactive and systematic approach to your work tasks

• possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills and can work independently in your area of responsibility and participate in a culture of knowledge sharing in an open, honest and trustful culture

• are a team player who thrives on solving complex problems together with your colleagues.

• speak and write English fluently and knowledge with a Scandinavian language is an advantage.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply. You’ll receive the training needed to maintain and further develop your competencies.

The role involves some travel, including two to three day trips per month to onshore sites, a two-week offshore campaign in summer, and a few conferences or courses each year.

Working at Ørsted

In the Asset Integrity department we have the responsibility for looking after some of Denmark’s most important infrastructure assets. We have highly skilled employees dedicated to safeguard and care for our assets.

We offer a collaborative, dynamic, and diverse workplace with constructive feedback and continuous learning, enabling our people to develop their expertise in asset integrity and engineering.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country. We don't take applications or inquiries from external recruiters or agencies into account for this position.

Position salary range:

For this position, the expected base pay range is kr54,480.00- kr68,100.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Your profile

International Product Manager
